basic_info.description: Bring your vision to life with this classic single-family home in the highly desirable Mission Terrace neighborhood. This diamond in the rough offers a spacious layout with original details, providing a fantastic opportunity for renovation and customization. The property features a generous living room, ample yard space, and significant expansion potential perfect for adding additional rooms or a home extension. Located just minutes from parks, schools, and local amenities, this home is an ideal project for investors or buyers seeking to create their dream residence. With some TLC and strategic updates, this property has the potential to become a beautiful, expanded family home in one of San Francisco's most appreciating neighborhoods.
